scope: Four short non-root Pods in a disposable kind cluster process only the checked-in synthetic stdout lines. A case-local process filter redacts lines carrying one exact synthetic name and retains both other lines. The test reads only the two case Pods' stdout and disables credential automount. A separate loopback-only HTTP handler compares an inert error response with and without a fixed response sanitizer. Production log aggregation, token protection, repository and image scanning, deployed API behavior, and external exposure remain separate.

checks.claim: The exact synthetic identifier reaches Pod stdout with the filter absent
Only the exact configured identifier's line is redacted before stdout
An unrelated name and a longer shared-prefix name remain intact
The inert bearer lookalike is visible in the unfiltered fixture path
The bearer value lookalike is removed before case-Pod stdout
The local repository check detects the inert bearer marker in a committed fixture
Current-tree scan is clean while history scan still identifies the prior canary commit
A loopback HTTP error response redacts the inert bearer marker and preserves safe fields
